iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Vision, Apple TV, Apple Watch

Focus, relax, and sleep through the power of sound. Endel creates AI-powered sounds designed to support your everyday life. Backed by science, and enjoyed by millions worldwide.

Endel is powered by its patented core AI technology. It takes inputs like location, environment, and heart rate, to create the optimal personalized soundscape. This happens on the fly and allows Endel to reconnect your state with your circadian rhythm.

Get access to the following classic soundscapes at home, work, or on the move to relax, concentrate, and minimize distractions and brain fatigue:

• Focus – boosts your productivity by helping you concentrate for longer

• Sleep – soothes you into a deep sleep with soft, gentle sounds

• Relax – calms your mind to create feelings of comfort and safety

• Move – feel grounded and present while walking, hiking, or running

ENDEL PREMIUM SUBSCRIPTION

Alongside the classics, the Premium package contains the following Endel Soundscapes and features:

• Colored Noise – choose one of 9 colors of noise to focus, relax, sleep, and mask outside sound

• Study – improves concentration and keeps you calm while studying or working

• Dynamic Focus – get your perfect productivity support with real-time sound tuning

• Hibernation – nourish your ears with cozy sounds for cold-season slumber

• Nature Elements – nurture the mind with sounds of nature, your way

• Rainy Outside – cozy up to the gentle patter of rain, blended with sleep-aiding sounds

• Recovery – revives your wellbeing with sounds engineered to lower anxiety

• Spatial Orbit – venture into a more peaceful dimension with an immersive Spatial Audio experience

• Focus Timer – the famous interval work method, upgraded with science-backed Focus sounds

On top of the much-loved original Endel soundscapes, Endel works with innovative artists and thinkers to create unique experiences. These collaborative Endel Soundscapes are available for Premium users:

• James Blake: Wind Down – prepare your body for sleep with soothing sounds from an award-winning artist

• Grimes: AI Lullaby – supports sleep for babies and adults with original sounds and vocals from Grimes

• Plastikman: Deeper Focus – a deep focus techno soundscape created with Richie Hawtin

• Alan Watts: Wiggly Wisdom – soothing and motivation spoken word soundscape, infused with the playful wisdom from Alan Watts

• Miguel: Clarity Trip – elevate your every step with original sounds from Miguel

Endel Pacific is the patented technology that powers our apps and integrations. All soundscapes are available offline.

Apart from the Premium sounds and features, Endel Premium users get access to the exclusive Apple Podcast shows.

SUBSCRIPTION TERMS

Skip the payment screen by tapping “X” in the top-right corner of the offer. The Free Edition of Endel will start automatically.

You can get access to Endel Premium by subscribing to a recurrent plan of your choice or with a one-time Lifetime purchase.

Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.

Payment will be charged to your Apple account at confirmation of purchase.

Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours of the end of the current period, and the cost of the renewal will be provided.

Subscriptions may be managed by the user. Auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase.

No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during the active subscription period.

Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication.

- I am a cancer survivor. I was diagnosed with stage 4 non Hodgkin Lymphoma right after being diagnosed with HIV...that was a tough week. I started out a frail 91 pounds and then found myself in active renal failure after my first chemotherapy infusion. I was dying. That little something I was missing. I’ve always known music to be a very powerful tool, but Endel’s approach is quite different. Anytime my little part of the world becomes to much, I put in my AirPods and enter my Soundscape....my heart rate goes back to normal, I’m taking long cleansing breaths and feeling better. - Endel honestly is an incredible app. The soundscape it designs can be very similar at times but I have found that it seems to always be unique but similar each time I use it. I downloaded the app because of the Grimes collab and honestly have fallen in love with it. It’s incredible. I can fall asleep so easily to it and often before would have trouble doing so. The focus setting also has helped me so much to be able to focus and zone in on work. I often pair this app with Flipd because the audio from the focus and deep work section can really get me to completely zone in on work and before I know it I’ve done a ton of work in an hour. Flipd then helps me to not use my phone when I should be focusing by giving me a study session that will restart if I exit. I Love using them both together and would recommend to developers if they’re looking for more features to add, look into what Flipd does and incorporate that in! A study timer being added into this that sends an annoying amount of push notifications if you exit in order to keep users from wandering onto social media when they should be working would really help in motivating users to stay focused! Overall, it’s a great app I would recommend to anyone who needs some ambient noise for studying, working, sleeping, meditating or whatever else! The only reason I give 4 stars instead of 5 is because I have fallen in love with the AI Lullaby feature and I’m sad it’s not going to be around forever. I would hands down keep my subscription if they did, because that feature is in my opinion the best of it all. I can focus well with it OR fall asleep easily. It’s incredible. Please don’t remove it!!

- I found Endel when it first came out, 2017 or so. I struggled with technical issues on my ancient phone but loved when it worked. While off grid in the woods for 2 weeks, this became my soundtrack on my iphone 12 mini, which I still use. At that point endel worked offline, with the most basic sounds free and no 10 minute limit. It was incredible and non-invasive in the natural space. I also used it at night on low volume to warn the cougars and bears of my presence. I didn't die! Yay! I finally purchased a year of it now, in 2026, because I need it more than ever being finally diagnosed with adhd and autism. I love focus, move and sleep-I love the way it supports my odd hours or focus and helps me rest easily for sleep. When I turn it off, I almost feel like I was being physically pushed and then, like the push is gone when I turn it off. It actually supports focus, aligns with neuroplasticity experiments and is simply my fave thing to listen to for all activities! It's expensive and I wish it was more accessible for lower income people. But even the free version is super helpful. LOVE IT!

myNoise offers 300+ immersive soundscapes, entirely customizable. Move the sliders to create the ambience that perfectly fits your needs. The app is designed as your daily companion: to focus, to sleep, or simply to relax.

Used by millions of users worldwide, myNoise is designed for long listening sessions, with an average listening time of over one hour per session.

WHAT PEOPLE USE IT FOR

There are thousands of reasons why you'd need to immerse yourself in an ambient sound you crafted yourself. Here are the most frequent ones:

• Focus & productivity. A stable audio environment for studying, remote work or the office. Widely used by people with ADHD, AuDHD or autism.
• Sleep. Build the ambience that helps you fall asleep, and cover whatever might wake you.
• Noise masking. Cover traffic, neighbours, an open-plan office or a noisy household. A steady background sound makes disruptive noise far easier to ignore.
• Stress & anxiety. Shut out the outside world when you need it most. Also used as PTSD support.
• Tinnitus relief. Tune a background sound that blends with your own ringing. Every tinnitus is different, so every sound here can be adjusted to match yours.
• Meditation & breathing, with a meditation bell to pace your sessions.

WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT

A lot of things! Try the app :) But here are the main reasons we're different:

• You shape the sound. Every soundscape has its own sliders. "White Noise & Co" alone covers white, brown, green, grey and pink noise, so a single soundscape can replace an entire app, or a physical noise machine. "Mediterranean Garden" lets you set the ocean waves, the wind, the cicadas.
• Or build your own. Creation Mode lets you combine up to 10 sliders taken from any soundscape in the app: rain from one, a drone from another, birds from a third.
• Professionally engineered. Every soundscape is built by research engineer Dr. Ir. Stéphane Pigeon and mixed for hours of comfortable listening. It keeps evolving and never loops back on itself.
• 100% human sound. Field recordings and real instruments. No AI-generated audio, ever.
• One purchase, for life. Free to download, no ads, no subscription. Unlock everything once and keep it, including every soundscape we release later.

INSIDE THE APP

• 300+ soundscapes: rain, forest, ocean, fireplace, fan, city ambiences, musical soundscapes, tonal drones and colored noises (white, brown, gray, pink, blue, green,...)
• Creation Mode, to build your own soundscape from up to 10 sliders
• A meditation bell you can set to ring at your own interval
• Presets to start from, and room to save your own
• Animate Mode, which moves the sliders for you so a soundscape keeps evolving
• Offline listening
• No ads, no subscription

Every soundscape comes with the story of how it was recorded, right inside the app.

If you have any question, always feel free to reach out to iOS@mynoise.net. Or just try the app, it's free!

# Use Background Sounds to help with sleep, focus, and more

Play ambient soundscapes on your iPhone, iPad, or Mac to listen to ocean, rain, bright noise sounds, and more. And in iOS 26, iPadOS 26, visionOS 26, and macOS Tahoe, use the Equalizer settings to adjust the levels of specific frequencies.

## Turn on Background Sounds on your iPhone or iPad

1. Open Control Center, then tap and hold the Background Sounds button. If you don't see it, [learn how to add the Background Sounds button to Control Center](https://support.apple.com/guide/iphone/use-and-customize-control-center-iph59095ec58/ios).

2. Tap Background Sounds![](https://cdsassets.apple.com/live/7WUAS350/images/ios-18-background-sounds-icon.png) to start or stop playing background sounds.

3. Tap on a sound to change the background sound and listen to a preview.
![iPhone displaying the Background Sounds menu with volume control and sound settings options.](https://cdsassets.apple.com/live/7WUAS350/images/ios/ios-26-iphone-16-pro-control-center-hearing-background-sounds.png)
4. Tap the background to go back to Control Center.


To stop playing when your device is locked or to lower the volume when other media is playing, change your Background Sounds Settings. Tap and hold the Background Sounds button in Control Center, scroll down and tap Background Sounds Settings, then choose an option.

If you [use Headphone Accommodations](https://support.apple.com/102663), AirPods Pro Hearing Aid Feature, or MFi hearing aids, your current settings are automatically applied to Background Sounds.

Background Sounds requires iOS 15 or iPadOS 15 or later

## Adjust the Equalizer for Background Sounds in iOS or iPadOS

The Equalizer settings on your iPhone are a way to personalize your preferred Background Sounds to increase your comfort and minimize distractions, like the chatter of a noisy train terminal.

To adjust the Equalizer:

1. Open Control Center, then tap and hold the Background Sounds button. If you don't see it, [learn how to add the Background Sounds button to Control Center](https://support.apple.com/guide/iphone/use-and-customize-control-center-iph59095ec58/ios).

2. Scroll down and tap Background Sounds Settings.

3. Tap Equalizer.

4. Turn Equalizer on or off, then adjust the sound to your preference with related settings. Drag the Balance slider to shift sounds left or right. Use the Tone grid to adjust the contour of sounds or select one of the options — tap Broad to hear wider frequency ranges with a richer sound or tap Focused to hear specific frequency ranges with less audio distraction.
![Go to Accessibility > Audio & Visual > Background Sounds > EQ to find the Equalizer (EQ) settings for Background Sounds in iOS 26.](https://cdsassets.apple.com/live/7WUAS350/images/ios/ios-26-iphone-16-pro-control-center-hearing-background-sounds-background-sounds-settings-equalizer-settings-on.png)
5. Tap the Back button when finished.


The Equalizer setting for Background Sounds requires iOS 26, iPadOS 26, visionOS 26, or macOS Tahoe or later.

## Turn on Background Sounds on your Mac or Apple Vision Pro

[Play rain sounds and other ambient noise with Background Sounds on your Mac](https://support.apple.com/guide/mac-help/play-background-sounds-mchl3061cdc6/mac)

[Play rain sounds and other ambient noise with Background Sounds on your Apple Vision Pro](https://support.apple.com/guide/apple-vision-pro/play-background-sounds-tancdbf42b14/visionos#)

## Background Sounds and sleep

Background Sounds like ocean, rain, or white noise might help a person relax and rest easier. Background Sounds is one of several tools on your iPhone—like the [Sound Therapy collection in Music](https://music.apple.com/us/multi-room/6505124012) or the Ambient Music control that you can [add to Control Center in iOS and iPadOS](https://support.apple.com/guide/iphone/use-and-customize-control-center-iph59095ec58/ios)—that might help you ease into a more restful sleep.

In iOS 26, iPadOS 26, visionOS 26, and macOS Tahoe, you can also add a timer to your Background Sounds so that the sounds stop at a specific time or after an amount of time. In the Settings app, go to Accessibility > Audio & Visual > Background Sounds, then tap Stop Sounds with a Timer.

## Background Sounds and the experience of tinnitus

Tinnitus, or the perception of sound that others do not hear, can happen to many people. With tinnitus, the sounds can take many forms but are most commonly described as a ringing sound and can be momentary or occur over longer durations. The experience of tinnitus can vary significantly from person to person and can change for an individual. Exposure to excessive levels of noise and stress can cause or worsen tinnitus.

Background Sounds can help minimize distractions to increase a sense of focus and relaxation, which some users find can help with tinnitus.

## Background Sounds and cognitive focus

To better focus on a task, your iPhone has tools that might help minimize distractions. Background Sounds or [the Sound Therapy collection in Music](https://music.apple.com/us/multi-room/6505124012) can help counteract surrounding sounds, while [Focus options](https://support.apple.com/guide/iphone/set-up-a-focus-iphd6288a67f/ios) can temporarily silence all notifications or allow only specific notifications—ones that apply to your task, for example—and let other people and apps know you’re busy.

In iOS 26, iPadOS 26, visionOS 26, and macOS Tahoe, you can also add a shortcut that turns on Background Sounds when you take a certain action, like turning on a Focus setting. Learn how to [create a shortcut on your iPhone or iPad](https://support.apple.com/guide/shortcuts/create-a-custom-shortcut-apd84c576f8c/ios) or [how to create a shortcut on your Mac](https://support.apple.com/guide/shortcuts-mac/create-a-custom-shortcut-apd84c576f8c/mac).
